cl-0Utw.title: Plants: purple lupine flowers along the road
cl-0Utw.summary: Large purple lupine flowers are common along one southern road.

cl-0n0t.title: Streetlight: orange lamps
cl-0n0t.summary: Orange street lamps are most common in two northern cities and rare in a third. They rarely appear in smaller cities, so check other clues.

cl-1mL6.title: Plants: pines with puffy needles
cl-1mL6.summary: Pine trees (Pinus radiata) with puffy needles. Most common in the south-central coast region, less so a bit north and south of it.

cl-2h86.title: Landscape: greener than the capital area, vineyards
cl-2h86.summary: Looks like the capital area but with a Mediterranean climate, generally greener, and many vineyards.

cl-69po.title: Google car: grey pickup, gear, antenna front right
cl-69po.summary: A grey Toyota Hilux pickup with gear loaded and a raised antenna pipe on the front right. The walking backpack continues on foot from a certain point.

cl-6sv4.title: Streetlight: silver top, grey bottom
cl-6sv4.summary: Lamps with a silver top and grey bottom, in two southern cities.

cl-8vz6.title: Landscape: rocky uneven mountains
cl-8vz6.summary: In the north: rocky, uneven mountains, most common in the northern desert and the region just south of it.

cl-90Z1.title: Coverage: sunset on two northern roads
cl-90Z1.summary: More Gen 4 sunset coverage on two roads. One has a slight ridge to the west, the other is more open. Use the road angle or other clues.

cl-96JZ.title: Landscape: vast open land, salt pans, snowy volcanoes
cl-96JZ.summary: A vast open landscape, then salt pans leading to snow-capped volcanoes. The road through it is paved.

cl-BUtb.title: Road: high altitude, steep drop to a valley
cl-BUtb.summary: On one northern road: very high altitude with a steep drop into a valley to the north. It also has older Gen 3 sunset coverage.

cl-C3HY.title: Landscape: lush green valleys, rocky peaks, overcast
cl-C3HY.summary: In the south: lush green valleys, rocky mountains and often overcast photos.

cl-CYSq.title: Coverage: autumn colours in the far south
cl-CYSq.summary: In the far south: orange and red autumn leaves, though not all coverage there has them.

cl-CmTv.title: Coverage: many radio telescopes, barren and snowy
cl-CmTv.summary: Many radio telescopes in a barren, snowy place.

cl-DDG0.title: Landscape: extremely dry desert, no plants
cl-DDG0.summary: In the northern third: sand and bare rock with no plants in sight, one of the driest places on earth. The same desert also covers parts of south Peru, west Bolivia and north-west Argentina.

cl-DbSe.title: Bollard: orange temporary with two white stripes
cl-DbSe.summary: Normal bollards are rare, but you may see a temporary orange one with two white stripes at the top.

cl-Dq9Y.title: Landscape: rolling farmland like New Zealand
cl-Dq9Y.summary: On a big southern island: rolling farmland that looks like New Zealand. Similar views exist elsewhere in the country but are usually flatter.

differs.how: Looks like New Zealand but this is flatter in other areas

cl-DujH.title: Streetlight: blue rectangle with yellow stripe
cl-DujH.summary: Blue rectangular lamps with a yellow stripe, in one south-central city.

cl-EIJH.title: Streetlight: lamps with photocells
cl-EIJH.summary: The capital's lamps very often have a light sensor on top. Rarely seen in other cities.

cl-GhN0.title: Phone numbers: two-digit area code then seven digits
cl-GhN0.summary: Numbers sometimes have a two-digit area code followed by seven digits. Central areas also have separate codes per province, which helps with guessing.

cl-Gw6y.title: Plants: giant cabbage-like leaves (Chilean rhubarb)
cl-Gw6y.summary: Chilean rhubarb has big cabbage-like leaves. Common on the big southern island and the mainland east of it.

cl-Imir.title: Road: dense plants, triple yellow lines, tar snakes
cl-Imir.summary: Dense plants beside the road, triple yellow lines and many tar snakes (crack-repair lines). In the east, many leafless dead trees.

cl-Jl4B.title: Plants: monkey puzzle trees
cl-Jl4B.summary: Monkey puzzle trees (Araucaria) grow in the far east of the south-central region. They also grow across the border in Argentina.

cl-JwjE.title: Road numbers: first letter runs A to Y, north to south
cl-JwjE.summary: Road names start with a letter that moves through the alphabet from A in the north to Y in the south.

cl-KTxH.title: Coverage: horse-mounted camera
cl-KTxH.summary: A camera carried on a horse, north-east of a central town. A similar one exists across the border in Argentina.

cl-PgUw.title: Pole: white with black number vs yellow
cl-PgUw.summary: In the far-north city the poles are white with a black number. Other desert cities have yellow poles, but faded paint can look white.

cl-Pjto.title: Landscape: rockier, more uneven ridge
cl-Pjto.summary: A rockier and more uneven ridge, in a northern coastal city.

cl-PmJu.title: Google car: white truck, mirrors, front antenna
cl-PmJu.summary: A white truck with visible side mirrors and an antenna on the front right. It marks one national park.

cl-Pt3R.title: Google car: towing white-silver trailer
cl-Pt3R.summary: The Google car pulls a white and silver trailer with the word Outback, south of a zoo in the capital.

cl-R9PE.title: Landscape: brown roadside dirt, juniper, overcast
cl-R9PE.summary: Brown dirt at the roadside, patches of light sand, juniper plants, dark mountains and mostly overcast skies. A similar park nearby has less vegetation.

cl-SjoP.title: Plate: white private, orange commercial
cl-SjoP.summary: Normal cars have white plates, taxis and commercial vehicles have orange ones. Ecuador also has orange plates. Brazilian commercial plates are red but can look orange in some light.

cl-UfwZ.title: Landscape: smooth sandy eroded mountains, valleys
cl-UfwZ.summary: In the far north: smooth, sandy mountains that look slightly eroded or have bulbous shapes. Valleys are common, which is rare elsewhere in the country.

cl-YLxR.title: Pole: round black poles
cl-YLxR.summary: Round poles painted black in one northern mining town.

cl-YjE4.title: Streetlight: green dome lamps
cl-YjE4.summary: Lamps shaped like green domes, in one northern city.

cl-Zgh9.title: Road: coast road, mountain wall east, Pacific west
cl-Zgh9.summary: A coastal road with a wall of mountains to the east and the Pacific Ocean to the west. The picture shows the different weather you may see.

cl-c7Jz.title: Houses: orange-stained wood, mountains to the east
cl-c7Jz.summary: A village with large mountains right to the east and snowy peaks far to the west. Street signs, fences and many buildings are orange-stained wood.

cl-cQZV.title: Google car: plain white, no antenna (older camera)
cl-cQZV.summary: In the older Gen 3 coverage (blurrier, softer colours): a white car with no antenna, either plain or with a visible black section (that one is unique here). Newer Gen 4 uses a blue car. Peru and Bolivia have plain white cars too.

cl-dcv9.title: Landscape: narrow roads with trees on both sides
cl-dcv9.summary: Narrow roads with trees on both sides are common in the south-central regions.

cl-dkLn.title: Sign: slots at the top of signposts
cl-dkLn.summary: Signposts often show slots at the top.

cl-ejML.title: Houses: clay brick walls with triangle tops
cl-ejML.summary: Clay brick walls, often with triangles at the top, in a northern desert village.

cl-exGJ.title: Landscape: salt pans, red sand, snowy mountain pass
cl-exGJ.summary: West: vast open land, salt pans and reddish sand leading to a line of mountains. East: a mountain pass with lightly snowy volcanoes and snow beside the road. Roads are paved.

cl-fFHl.title: Climate: desert north, cold wet far south
cl-fFHl.summary: A very long, narrow country: dry desert in the north, a mild Mediterranean climate in the middle around the capital, and cold wet weather in the far south.

cl-fmHE.title: Chevron: yellow with black arrows
cl-fmHE.summary: Chevrons are yellow with black arrows. Argentina uses white with red arrows.

differs.how: Argentina's are white with red arrows

cl-hgxy.title: Landscape: brownish-red soil
cl-hgxy.summary: In the northern desert: brownish red soil. Most reliable in older Gen 3 coverage; in Gen 4 it appears in other regions too.

cl-jKZj.title: Sign: orange street signs at almost every junction
cl-jKZj.summary: Orange street name signs at nearly every intersection in one small southern city, and occasionally in a nearby town.

cl-jabn.title: Plants: tamarugo trees lining a mediocre road
cl-jabn.summary: In the northern desert reserve: tamarugo trees line a so-so road that heads steadily north-west.

cl-kuAd.title: Coverage: sharp peaks, glacier walkers, orange helmets
cl-kuAd.summary: Sharp-peaked mountains and the camera walking on a glacier among other people wearing orange helmets.

cl-lm-3090.title: Google car: leafy stick on the back
cl-lm-3090.summary: In the far north, a small stick with a few leaves is sometimes attached to the back of the car.

cl-lm-55173.title: Landscape: lone snowy volcano, yareta, feather grass
cl-lm-55173.summary: A flat high plateau with tall snowy mountains behind, Peruvian feather grass and cushion-shaped yareta plants. Chilean bollards line the road (very rare). A tall snow-capped volcano stands alone, away from other ridges, and is visible almost everywhere in the park.

cl-lm-55210.title: Plants: copao cactus
cl-lm-55210.summary: A tall cactus (cactus ácido, or copao) found only in this country, in the semi-arid north and north-centre and the central coast.

cl-lm-643928.title: Landscape: green river valley with railway, fan palms
cl-lm-643928.summary: A wide valley with sloping sandy mountains that have round rock bumps, lots of farmland by desert standards, green fields with bushes or wooden fences, planted fan palms, and a railway following the river.

cl-lm-643929.title: Road: new wide road, yellow barriers, red sand hills
cl-lm-643929.summary: A newly paved, wide road climbing out of the valley: concrete barriers (often yellow), double guardrails, drains, sometimes maroon asphalt, and light reddish sand mountains with round bumps. No plants at first, then small green bushes further east.

cl-lm-643934.title: Plants: Chilean wine palm
cl-lm-643934.summary: A palm that grows only in a small central area, most densely around the coastal resort city.

cl-mOVz.title: Landscape: snowy line of peaks and two lone volcanoes
cl-mOVz.summary: In a northern national park: a line of snow-capped mountains plus two isolated, symmetrical snow-capped volcanoes. Roads are newly paved, smooth and dark.

cl-nARv.title: Landscape: vast treeless land, triple yellow lines
cl-nARv.summary: A vast, mostly treeless land with triple yellow lines and a cold, high-altitude feel even if dry. Monkey puzzle trees appear to the east. The road leading up has triple yellow lines too but is less vast and greener.

cl-nGYF.title: Landscape: smooth reddish mountains, salt pans
cl-nGYF.summary: Smooth, reddish-tinted mountains and salt pans. The reserve uses triple yellow lines, with short dashes in the west.

cl-nI4v.title: Streetlight: grey, thin flat top, rounded underside
cl-nI4v.summary: Grey lamps with a thin flat top and a rounded underside, in one central city.

cl-nN6I.title: Road lines: dotted paint
cl-nN6I.summary: In the south: road lines made of dotted paint are common.

cl-oPtv.title: Road lines: all white or all yellow
cl-oPtv.summary: Lines are either all white (most common) or all yellow (national parks and snowy areas), almost never mixed. All-yellow is essentially unique in the Americas. Argentina also has many all-white roads.

differs.how: Argentina also has many all-white roads, but no all-yellow ones

cl-rTlS.title: Landscape: slight sandy ridge, gradual slope
cl-rTlS.summary: A slight, sandy ridge with a gradual slope, in the far-north coastal city.

cl-rsYl.title: Landscape: dry hills, scattered plants
cl-rsYl.summary: Around the capital: a semi-arid climate with dry hills and scattered vegetation.

cl-rzZ2.title: Coverage: big radio telescopes and rural facilities
cl-rzZ2.summary: Large radio telescopes with plain rural buildings around them.

cl-s7lU.title: Road: valley, snowy peaks, triple yellow lines
cl-s7lU.summary: A valley road with snowy mountains in the distance, many trees and vineyards to the west, and triple yellow lines at some points.

cl-t5nN.title: Google car: white pickup with visible side mirrors
cl-t5nN.summary: A white pickup with visible side mirrors in the southernmost town covered. Its coverage is far from the normal car coverage; the nearest is near a southern city.

cl-tCeP.title: Bollard: Spanish style, white front, orange back
cl-tCeP.summary: A bollard with a white reflector on the front and a yellow-orange one on the back, like in Spain. Not very common.

cl-tcEu.title: Landscape: large towering ridge
cl-tcEu.summary: A bigger, towering ridge behind a northern coastal city.

cl-uW2V.title: Bridge: red painted fence posts
cl-uW2V.summary: Bridges often have red painted fence posts.

cl-vasL.title: Coverage: sunset, white dome, pink volcano tops
cl-vasL.summary: Newer Gen 4 sunset coverage on one northern road. Near the west the sun is just setting, making a big white dome in the sky; in the east the sky has a warm gradient and the volcano tops glow pink.

cl-vcdo.title: Road: all yellow lines on concrete, treeless
cl-vcdo.summary: All-yellow lines on a concrete road point to the far south, with barren, grassy, treeless land. One of these roads only appears in older Gen 3 coverage; the others are Gen 4.

cl-y9xj.title: Pole: square concrete, indented sides, pinholes
cl-y9xj.summary: Square concrete poles with an indent on both sides and small pinholes near the top. Brazilian poles are similar but have more horizontal supports in the indent. Wooden poles are common too.

differs.how: Brazilian poles have more bars across the indent

cl-ylGg.title: Plants: eucalyptus plantations in a dry climate
cl-ylGg.summary: Eucalyptus plantations with a fairly dry climate point to the south-west of the central coastal region.
